entries.subject: DAMIT 6183: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 6183, version 2022-02-14, pole (158°, 25°), period 23.6727 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 6184 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 113.699 ± 2.449 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 113.699 ± 2.449 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "56.85 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 362, DAMIT model 6183 diameter 100 ± 4 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 6183 fitted to 7 occultations); the shown value is kept.

entries.subject: Faina whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 20 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.946 at 462 nm, 0.960 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#2d2e2c in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 2.7% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 1.3%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2017, AJ 154, 168; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
